text: Approximately 40 mg of the sample was packed into a silanized glass column (3 mm inner diameter) to form a fixed bed with a height of ca. 30 mm. Prior to the measurement, the sample underwent a strict activation protocol to ensure the complete removal of preadsorbed species: the material was first activated at 80 °C under high vacuum (10–5 Torr) for 20 h, followed by in situ activation at 80 °C under a pure N2 flow (50 sccm) for 2 h. After cooling to the adsorption temperature of 25 °C, the gas stream was switched from N2 to a feed gas containing 410 ppm of CO2 at a total flow rate of 50 sccm to initiate the adsorption process.

source.title: Benchmarking CO2 Adsorbents for Direct Air Capture with an Amine-Grafted Metal–Organic Framework
